UAE national swimming record broken | Charlotte Fairbairn interview
videos.description:
Charlotte Fairbairn of Repton Al Barsha, Dubai set a new UAE National Record for 10-year-olds' 50m Breaststroke at The World School Swim Championships on Sunday!

Her impressive heat time of 39.97 secs at the prestigious event in London, UK was enough to break the previous record & represented the achievement of a goal she'd been working towards for months.

Charlotte then went on to take Gold in the U11 Girls 50m Breaststroke Final that afternoon to cap off fantastic performances on the world stage.

Congratulations, Charlotte!
